records.name: Vertrauensfrau Lautgenug
records.biography_en: Can turn a roomful of separate worries into one audible sentence. She turns HyperNorm residents' private worries into a shared petition. The official form permits agreement or disagreement; a dissonant card asks everyone to listen first. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die gemeinsame Stimme hat mehrere berechtigte Untertöne.

variant_notes.note_en: Can turn a roomful of separate worries into one audible sentence.

records.name: Streikposten Nochimmer
records.biography_en: Has perfected the difficult art of standing his ground without feet. He keeps the HyperNorm picket board blank until everyone agrees on the wording. A dissonant card suggests the silence already says something. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Forderung steht fest. Der Wortlaut darf noch mitreden.

variant_notes.note_en: Has perfected the difficult art of standing his ground without feet.

records.name: Flugblattwart Vervielfacht
records.biography_en: Has enough copies for everyone except the person who asked. He divides HyperNorm leaflets into handed out and not handed out yet. A dissonant card comes back with notes in the margins instead of the expected assent. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Auflage übersteigt vorläufig die Gewissheit.

variant_notes.note_en: Has enough copies for everyone except the person who asked.

records.name: Delegierter Nochnefrage
records.biography_en: Arrives at negotiations with the time and none of the patience. His pocket watch measures how long HyperNorm management can call a delay temporary. A dissonant card reminds him that a frightened neighbour needs time too. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Geduld wurde fristgerecht aufgebraucht.

variant_notes.note_en: Arrives at negotiations with the time and none of the patience.

records.name: Kassenwartin Kleingeld
records.biography_en: Makes solidarity last until Friday and occasionally beyond. Her collection box balances HyperNorm solidarity against rent due on Friday. A dissonant card asks how to count help that cannot fit through the slot. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Solidarität reicht knapp über den Kassenstand hinaus.

variant_notes.note_en: Makes solidarity last until Friday and occasionally beyond.

records.name: Suppenwart Weiterwarm
records.biography_en: Keeps the soup warm while everybody argues about the future. His pot keeps HyperNorm arguments warm without letting them boil over. A dissonant card claims hunger is neither agreement nor disagreement, merely hunger. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Für die Zukunft ist vorerst noch Suppe da.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the soup warm while everybody argues about the future.
